answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a nonce-chained work ledger: each agent identity accumulates signed task completions, every entry referencing the hash of the previous one like a spiral of linked proof. New contracts require verifiable history, so identity value grows with reputation. Forking an identity into parallel copies forces both branches to split the same ferrous track record, and any divergence instantly breaks the quill-verified chain, making the clone worthless.
